name: Keenious
tagline: Academic search engine that finds research papers from a question or from your own text, on the web and in Word and Google Docs, with an AI chat about papers and uploaded PDFs

evidence.quote: Keenious AS is the controller for the processing described in this policy.
Its registered address is Keenious AS, Sykehusvegen 23, Tromsø, Troms 9019, Norway.

parent_company.note: Read the privacy policy, terms of use, about page (founders and team, started at UiT Tromsø), contact page and help centre. No parent or owner company is named. A web search found only minority investors listed on third-party sites, no acquisition.

parent_country.note: No separate parent company found (see Parent company).

evidence.quote: We are registered in Norway and have our registered office at Sykehusvegen 23
If you have questions about this notice or our practices, contact privacy@keenious.com

dpo_contact.note: No named DPO in the privacy policy. The VPAT names a compliance co-ordinator for accessibility only.

evidence.quote: All data is processed in the EU across Ireland, Belgium, France, and Germany.
Keenious processes and hosts prompts, messages, files, and AI responses within the European Union (specifically Ireland, Belgium, and Germany).

hosting_regions.note: The privacy policy names Ireland, Belgium and Germany; the universities page and the environment article add France.

evidence.quote: recommends relevant research papers by analyzing your text with powerful artificial intelligence algorithms
Content the user submits, for example, documents, selected excerpts, queries, instructions, and feedback.

local_first.note: Text and PDFs are sent to Keenious for analysis. No local-only mode found in the help centre, download page or pricing.

evidence.quote: All data is processed in the EU across Ireland, Belgium, France, and Germany.
Our infrastructure, hosted across Google Cloud and AWS, also draws water for cooling
Chat runs on Claude Haiku 5.5 hosted on Google Cloud EU region

transfer_mechanism.note: Privacy policy, terms and universities page state EU processing but name no DPF, SCCs or BCRs for any transfer. The sub-processor list and DPA were not readable (Trust Center documents need access requests).

evidence.quote: A list of subprocessors, including their locations, is available upon request.
Published list of all subprocessors and their hosting locations.

subprocessors_public.note: Sources differ: the universities page says the list is published, the privacy policy says on request and names a PDF ('Approved Subprocessors For Keenious.pdf') that is not linked. The Trust Center (trust.keenious.com) holds documents behind 'Request Access'. No public list could be read.

subprocessors_count.note: List not readable (see Sub-processors public). Named providers in public pages: Google (Cloud, Gemini), AWS, Anthropic (Claude via Google Cloud), Stripe (payments), Intercom (help centre). Not counted as a list.

subprocessor_notice.note: No notice of new sub-processors found in the privacy policy, terms or universities page. DPA not readable.

evidence.quote: Institutional licences include a full data processing agreement.
GDPR-compliant DPA and EU hosting

dpa.footnote: DPA listed only for university (campus) licences; Free, Plus and Team plans have none stated.
dpa.note: keenious.com/dpa returns 404. No public DPA text found.

evidence.quote: Keenious AS is the controller for the processing described in this policy.
Keenious acts as a processor on behalf of the user's organization, and the organization is the controller for those features.

role.footnote: Processor for institutional accounts; controller for individual users.
role.note: Controller for direct users. Processor for institutional accounts.

evidence.quote: Last updated January 2026
The default retention period for raw prompts and outputs is 24 hours, after which it will be deleted.
Keenious temporarily retains conversation content and uploaded files for up to one day.

retention_stated.note: Privacy policy also says inactive backup data is removed after 90 days.

deletion_on_exit.note: Privacy policy says data is deleted when no longer needed and backups after 90 days, but deletion of account data after termination is not described. DPA not readable.

evidence.quote: export of whole result lists and bookmarks as CSV, RIS, BibTeX, CSL JSON, or formatted citations

data_export.footnote: Exporting whole result lists is a Plus feature (included in campus licences).
data_export.note: Result lists and bookmarks can be exported. Chats are deleted after one day; no chat export found.

breach_notice.note: No breach-notification window in the privacy policy, terms or universities page. DPA not readable.

evidence.quote: These conditions are governed by and interpreted following the laws of Norway
the entire search engine works with or without the AI companion
search results are retrieved from the index, not generated by a language model

ai_features.note: Generative AI is used in Chat and for research-area names. Search uses embeddings and keyword ranking.

evidence.quote: Chat runs on Claude Haiku 5.5 hosted on Google Cloud EU region
The short names shown for research areas are generated by a smaller, faster Gemini model.

ai_providers.note: Claude model is run on Google Cloud. Privacy policy also names Google Gemini as an LLM provider.

evidence.quote: Keenious does not use user prompts, inputs, or outputs to train its models or the models of its providers.
We do not use your inputs or outputs to train our models or our providers' models.
Providers do not use the user's prompts or outputs to improve their models.

ai_zero_retention.note: Keenious itself keeps prompts and outputs for 24 hours. No zero-retention or no-logging statement for the model providers found.

ai_admin_off.note: Universities and librarians pages list admin settings (welcome message, citation prompt, 2FA) and say campus AI guidance is coming, but no switch to turn the AI companion off.

ai_act_statement.note: No EU AI Act statement found in the privacy policy, terms, help centre (llms.txt index), universities or librarians pages.

evidence.quote: operates an ISO 27001 certified information security management system
Our audit was conducted in December 2025 by Johanson Group and supported by Thoropass .

certifications.note: Certificate itself not seen; the Trust Center page read lists 'No Certifications Added'.

evidence.quote: Use this portal to learn about our governance posture as well as request access to our documentation.

trust_page.note: Documents need 'Request Access' and were not requested. A fresh fetch on 2026-11-17 returned an empty script-rendered page; the 2026-11-16 copy is quoted.

evidence.quote: User data is encrypted in transit and while being stored.
Certified security management with annual third-party penetration testing.

pentest.note: No report summary published; Trust Center documents are gated.

vuln_disclosure.note: https://keenious.com/.well-known/security.txt and /security return 404. No disclosure policy in the help centre or legal pages.

incidents.note: Web searches for Keenious breaches, security incidents and Datatilsynet cases returned nothing about Keenious. No vendor notice found.

status_page.note: status.keenious.com does not resolve. No status page linked from the homepage, footer or sitemap.

evidence.quote: They sign in with your single sign-on over SAML, or with their institutional email address.
You can also sign up using Google or Microsoft.

sso.footnote: SAML SSO is part of the university licence; Google and Microsoft sign-in are open to all accounts.

federation.note: Web search for Keenious with Feide, eduGAIN and SWAMID found no listing. Federation metadata not searched directly.

scim.note: Not stated on pricing, universities, librarians or help pages.

evidence.quote: Admins can require two-factor authentication for users and for admins separately.
Two-factor authentication (2FA) controls

mfa.note: Help article describes authenticator-app 2FA with Optional, Enforced or Disabled institution policies.

evidence.quote: Institution admins get an Analytics tab in Keenious with a usage dashboard for your campus
Admin console for seat management

admin_console.footnote: Usage dashboard on university licences; Team plan has seat management only.

audit_logs.note: Privacy policy mentions internal audit logging as a security measure, but no admin-visible audit log is described.

lms_integration.note: Universities page names link resolver, SSO and Word add-in deployment. No LMS integration found.

evidence.quote: The results are published as a Voluntary Product Accessibility Template (VPAT)

vpat.note: The PDF is linked from the help article; it is dated February 2025 (updated May 2025) and labels the product version 'OUT OF DATE'. The universities page says a full VPAT is available on request.

evidence.quote: Keenious is assessed against the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 at Level AA.
Accessible by design, with a full VPAT available on request.

wcag_level.note: The same article lists nine criteria as Partially Supports and none as Does Not Support.

evidence.quote: To report an accessibility problem, email <contact@keenious.com>.

accessibility_statement.note: The help article is the page linked as 'Accessibility' in the site footer; keenious.com/accessibility returns 404.

hecvat.note: No HECVAT on keenious.com, help centre or Trust Center page read.

ferpa.note: Not stated in the privacy policy, terms, universities page or help centre.

hipaa_baa.note: Not stated on the pages read.

section_508.note: Not stated. The VPAT is the WCAG edition only.

state_privacy.note: No SDPC, CCPA or NY Ed Law 2-d terms found in the privacy policy or terms.

uk_gdpr.note: No UK transfer terms found; DPA not readable.

au_privacy.note: No Australian Privacy Principles statement, IRAP or Australian hosting found.

nis2.note: Not stated on the pages read.

evidence.quote: The free plan has no time limit
$10 / month, billed annually

price_individual.note: Individual Plus plan, 'Starting at'. Team plan $20 / user / month, billed annually.

evidence.quote: Annual campus license
Keenious is licensed campus-wide so everyone at your institution gets the same access and library integration under one agreement.

institutional_licence.note: Campus-wide only, priced by FTE; single-department licences are not offered (Team plan covers groups).

evidence.quote: Students get 30% off annual Individual plans.
Custom quote by institution size

pricing_public.note: Individual and Team prices are published. University pricing is by quote.

evidence.quote: Explore scholarly literature on the web, Microsoft Word, and Google Docs.
discussing uploaded PDFs
Open a key paper and follow its citations to the work that builds on it.
Formatted citations in styles such as APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, and Vancouver.

capabilities.note: Bookmarks and RIS/BibTeX export feed reference managers (Zotero, EndNote, Mendeley); Keenious itself is not described as a reference manager. The universities page says the companion declines to write drafts or summarize a field.

evidence.quote: Keenious is a new type of academic search engine that recommends relevant research papers
Web app, Microsoft Word, and Google Docs add-ins

platforms.note: Also a Google Docs add-on (Google Workspace Marketplace), which has no option in the list.

languages.note: Interface languages not listed. The index covers 126-173 publication languages and Chat can explain in the user's language, but that is content, not the interface.

api.note: No public API documentation found on keenious.com, the sitemap or the help centre index.

evidence.quote: the Keenious Products are our proprietary property
Setup takes days with zero local installation.

self_host.note: No self-hosting option found; campus deployment is hosted by Keenious.
